transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... most days lately, I just feel like I’m sitting at the bottom of a dark hole. It's just this heavy, hopeless feeling. And even when I’m around people I know, I just can’t seem to shake it.
Have you ever had a distinct period when you felt unusually high or irritable and had much more energy than usual?

No, I... I don't think so. I've never really had a time where I felt unusually high or had a bunch of extra energy like that. Honestly, it's pretty much just the exact opposite. I'm just completely drained.
How long have you been feeling this depressed continuously?

It's been... about a year and two months now. It started right after I had a fall at work—I do HVAC repair, or I did, anyway. The fall left me with a bad back injury, and... well, that's when everything just started unraveling. It's been continuous since then.
During this time, have you lost interest in or stopped enjoying activities that you usually like?

Yeah, I have. I used to love doing things like... well, hiking, painting, tinkering at the makerspace. I even used to really enjoy figuring out a tricky install at work. But now... I just don't have any interest in any of it. 

I'll just sit and stare at my supplies, or I'll ignore calls from people when they reach out. It's just that none of it even feels worth starting anymore.
Have you had thoughts that you would be better off dead or thoughts of killing yourself?

Yes, I have. I've been having thoughts that... well, that everyone would just be better off if I didn't wake up. And sometimes, especially when the back pain is really bad and the money worries just keep piling up, I catch myself actually thinking about ending it. It scares me when I think like that, but... the thoughts are there.
Do you currently have a specific plan to end your life?

No... no, I don't. I haven't actually figured out how I would do it or made any kind of plan. Like I said, the thoughts are there, but it's more just wanting everything to stop rather than actually planning out a way to do it.
During this depressive period, have you heard or seen things that others could not, or believed things that others told you were not true?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I haven't heard voices or seen things that aren't there. And I don't think I've believed anything strange like that either. It's just... mostly the sadness and the thoughts I mentioned. None of that other stuff.
How much has your depression interfered with your ability to manage your usual daily responsibilities?

It's interfered a lot. I just... I haven't been able to keep up with my field work at all, or even the business side of my jobs. I've started missing calls, missing deadlines... letting bills slide that I used to handle without even thinking about it. 

I'm also just pulling away from people. I don't see my friends, I stopped going to the makerspace... Honestly, most days I'm really just trying to get through safely at home. Just making it through the day is about all I can manage right now.
